tools.name: talentlyft_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs in the TalentLyft account, filterable by status and text. Use the returned job ids with talentlyft_get_job and talentlyft_list_job_stages. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/jobs.

tools.name: talentlyft_get_job
tools.description: Get one job by id, including its details. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_job_stages
tools.description: List the hiring stages of one job, in order. Use a stage id with talentlyft_move_application_to_stage. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/jobs/{id}/stages.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_candidates
tools.description: List candidates, optionally only those who applied for some jobs or were created after a date. Returns candidate ids for talentlyft_get_candidate. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/candidates.

tools.name: talentlyft_get_candidate
tools.description: Get one candidate by id, with contact details, tags, and the list of applications (each with its job and stage). TalentLyft API: GET /v2/candidates/{id}.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_candidate_activities
tools.description: List the timeline activities of one candidate (notes, stage moves, and other events). TalentLyft API: GET /v2/candidates/{id}/activities.

tools.name: talentlyft_get_application
tools.description: Get one application of a candidate (one candidate for one job), with its stage, evaluation and answers. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/candidates/{id}/applications/{applicationId}.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the hiring pipelines (the stage sets that jobs use). TalentLyft API: GET /v2/pipelines.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_departments
tools.description: List the departments of the company. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/departments.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_members
tools.description: List the team members of the company (recruiters and managers), with their ids. Use a member id as the author of a note or a stage move. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/members.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_rejection_reasons
tools.description: List the rejection reasons that the company uses when it disqualifies a candidate. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/rejection_reasons.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events (interviews and meetings), filterable by date range, job, candidate, or member. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/events.

tools.name: talentlyft_add_candidate_note
tools.description: Write a note on a candidate's timeline, as the given team member. The note is visible to the team. Each call creates a new note. TalentLyft API: POST /v2/candidates/{id}/note.

tools.name: talentlyft_move_application_to_stage
tools.description: Move one candidate application to another hiring stage of its job, as the given team member. TalentLyft may send the candidate or the team the usual stage notifications. TalentLyft API: POST /v2/candidates/{id}/applications/{applicationId}/move_to_stage/{stageId}.
